designIntent: Resume the existing Main composition at its real blocked call chain, but consume the accepted V4 authority instead of recreating selection or grouping in Main. In trusted Main bootstrap, load the existing stable host Ed25519 custody and separately persisted pre-approved public trust policy, open the Agent production Evidence Ledger and witness authority, and inject only the opaque createDurableSemanticReviewRuntime result into per-task orchestration. Carry Core's exact two-binding V4 request through the existing strict analysis result, serialize the V4 attestation into the existing journal/checkpoint with public policy/execution hashes, verify and consume it through Core before terminal closure/persistence/G3/G4/CAS, and prove fresh-process resume without reminting.
